newsitem.title: BURMA: Burma police seize 107 kg of heroin.
newsitem.headline: Burma police seize 107 kg of heroin.

text.p: Burmese anti-narcotics officials last week seized 107 kg (234.9 lbs) of heroin in separate raids.
Official media said anti-narcotics squads confiscated 65.8 kgs (144.7 lbs) of heroin from six occupants of a car in Lashio, 600 miles (375 kms) northeast of Rangoon on Wednesday.

They said government agents on Thursday arrested three people in Muse Township near the Chinese border, about 700 miles (437.5 kms) northeast of Rangoon, after 38 kgs (83.6 lbs) of heroin and a pistol were found in their house.
On Monday police seized 3.2 kgs (seven lbs) of heroin from four people in a car in Mandalay, central Burma.
